rules.statement: Failure to register a lis pendens in a partition action as required by section 12 (1) of the Registration of Documents Ordinance deprives the decree entered in the action of the 'conclusive effect' which it would otherwise have under section 9 of the Partition Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "The one clear instance of a failure of jurisdiction laid down by the Privy Council is where the breach of a procedural provision results in the violation of natural justice. In the case before us there is no such violation."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Registration of Documents Ordinance (Cap. 101), s. 12 (1); Partition Ordinance (Cap. 56), ss. 3, 9, 17.
